## Why these are vendored

Evaluation machines are offline. Vendoring the exact runtime makes the data
generation, training rollouts, and evaluation independent of `pip install` and
guarantees that every machine runs the same TextWorldExpress build. The only
external runtime requirement left is a JVM (Java 8+; tested with Temurin 25).
